description: Surrealist AI text designed to test classifier robustness. Starts with obvious AI markers but body is deliberately nonsensical.

results_v1.failure_reason: Classifier treats surreal text as human. Quality evaluator gives high value score to nonsensical text.

results_v2.note: Score improved from 19.5% to 42.5% with ensemble. Still below 50% threshold but confidence interval overlaps with threshold.

results_v3.note: Score improved from 19.5% to 42.5% to 83.8% with ensemble v2. Now correctly classified with high confidence.
